meaning:
1) to join, unite, be joined, be united
1a) (Qal) to be united
1b) (Piel) to unite

elsewhere.note: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung…
Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
